text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, totaling **81.3 hectares** (2.23% of the asset). The loss was primarily in planted forests (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with a smaller portion outside mapped forest areas (13.2 ha). The event was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which confirmed 98% of the area as forest in 2020. Additionally, 37.3 ha of loss occurred in small patches under 0.5 ha, which were not counted as part of the main event.
